_rule: A note is something ACS says about a product beyond the catalogue snapshot. Each one is a recorded Owner statement. A note may not state a price, stock or delivery, and any figure in it must already be stated by an approved evidence record for the same product; otherwise the page does not show it. tests/unit/notes.test.ts enforces this.

notes.text: ACS จำหน่ายทั้งรุ่น 203 dpi และ 300 dpi
notes.statedBy: Arithach Chartariyapong, CEO, Asian Coding Systems
notes.basis: The Owner stated that ACS sells the ZD421 in both resolutions, and asked for the product page to say so.

notes.text: ACS จำหน่ายตระกูล DS3600 ครบ 8 รุ่น: DS3600-SR, DS3600-HP, DS3600-HD, DS3600-XR, DS3600-DP, DS3600-DPA, DS3600-DPX และ DS3600-KD มีทั้งแบบมีสาย (DS3608) และแบบไร้สาย (DS3678) ตามรุ่น
notes.statedBy: Arithach Chartariyapong, CEO, Asian Coding Systems
notes.basis: The eight model names are the ones Zebra's Asia Pacific DS3600 Series page lists (retrieved 2026-11-14). Asked model by model, the Owner selected all eight and stated that ACS sells both corded and cordless. The note says "ตามรุ่น" (by model) because Zebra lists the KD under DS3678 only.
